description: Content-aware crop to an aspect ratio, keeping the salient subject (edges + saturation) rather than the centre. aspect like "1:1", "16:9", "4:5".

height.description: Explicit target height in pixels; an alternative to aspect

input.description: Path to the image to crop

output.description: Destination path; its extension chooses the encoder

width.description: Explicit target width in pixels; an alternative to aspect

name: crop
